reasoning.trend_analysis: Revenue showed consistent growth of 7.88% from 2022 to 2023. COGS grew minimally (0.19%), leading to a significant improvement in gross profit margin from 66.55% to 68.93%. Operating expenses grew at a slower rate (5.45%) than revenue, resulting in an improved operating margin (43.01% to 45.93%). Net income saw very strong growth (22.51%), with its margin expanding from 34.62% to 39.31%. On the balance sheet, total assets slightly decreased by -0.53% in 2023, while current assets and cash grew robustly (12.66% and 14.28% respectively). Total liabilities decreased by -3.29%, indicating debt management, while current liabilities grew moderately (4.99%). Equity increased by 5.63%. Cash flow from operations grew by 8.06%, maintaining a stable percentage of revenue (around 50.5%). Capital expenditures (Capex) increased in absolute terms but remained stable as a percentage of revenue (around 1.27%). Free cash flow grew by 8.16%.
